chapters.title: Israel Numbered for War
chapters.synopsis: In the wilderness of Sinai the Lord commands Moses to number all men able to go to war, tribe by tribe. The count reaches 603,550, while the Levites are set apart to tend the tabernacle.

chapters.title: The Order of the Camp
chapters.synopsis: The Lord arranges the twelve tribes around the tabernacle, each under its own standard on the east, south, west, and north. Israel camps and marches in this appointed order.

chapters.title: The Levites Given to Aaron
chapters.synopsis: The Lord takes the tribe of Levi in place of Israel's firstborn and gives them to Aaron to serve the tabernacle. The Levite families are numbered and assigned their charges around the sanctuary.

chapters.title: Service of the Levite Families
chapters.synopsis: The Lord assigns the Kohathites, Gershonites, and Merarites their duties in carrying the sanctuary and its furnishings. All who serve between thirty and fifty years of age are numbered for the work.

chapters.title: Purity Within the Camp
chapters.synopsis: The Lord commands that the unclean be put outside the camp and that trespasses be confessed with restitution. He gives the trial of jealousy for a wife suspected of unfaithfulness.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: camp purity and the jealousy trial

chapters.title: The Nazarite and the Blessing
chapters.synopsis: The Lord gives the vow of the Nazarite, who abstains from wine and leaves his hair uncut as one separated unto God. He then teaches Aaron the priestly blessing that puts the Lord's name upon Israel.

chapters.title: Offerings of the Twelve Princes
chapters.synopsis: At the dedication of the altar the prince of each tribe brings identical offerings on twelve successive days. Moses then hears the voice of the Lord speaking from off the mercy seat.

chapters.title: The Levites Cleansed for Service
chapters.synopsis: Aaron lights the seven lamps, and the Levites are washed, presented, and offered to the Lord in place of Israel's firstborn. They begin their service at twenty-five and retire from labor at fifty.

chapters.title: The Passover and the Cloud
chapters.synopsis: Israel keeps the passover at Sinai, and the Lord provides a second passover for those who were unclean or far away. The cloud covers the tabernacle, and Israel journeys or rests only at the Lord's command.

chapters.title: Trumpets and the Journey Begins
chapters.synopsis: The Lord commands two silver trumpets to call the assembly and to sound alarms. In the second year the cloud lifts, and Israel departs from Sinai in ordered ranks, the ark going before them.

chapters.title: Fire, Quails, and Seventy Elders
chapters.synopsis: The people complain and fire from the Lord burns at Taberah; then they lust for flesh and weep for Egypt. The Lord puts his Spirit on seventy elders to help Moses and sends quails, followed by a plague.

chapters.title: Miriam and Aaron Murmur
chapters.synopsis: Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses, but the Lord declares that he speaks with Moses mouth to mouth. Miriam is struck with leprosy, and at Moses' plea she is healed after seven days outside the camp.

chapters.title: Spies Search the Promised Land
chapters.synopsis: Twelve men, one from each tribe, search the land of Canaan for forty days and return with its fruit. Ten spies spread an evil report of walled cities and giants, while Caleb urges Israel to go up at once.

segments.speaker: moses
segments.note: the twelve spies and their report

chapters.title: Forty Years of Wandering Decreed
chapters.synopsis: Israel weeps, rebels, and seeks to return to Egypt despite the pleas of Joshua and Caleb. Moses intercedes, and the Lord pardons but decrees that the faithless generation will die during forty years in the wilderness.

chapters.title: Offerings and the Sabbath Breaker
chapters.synopsis: The Lord gives laws of offerings for the land Israel will yet inherit, with one law for Israelite and stranger alike. A man gathering sticks on the sabbath is stoned, and Israel is commanded to wear fringes of remembrance.

chapters.title: The Rebellion of Korah
chapters.synopsis: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram rise against Moses and Aaron, claiming all the congregation is holy. The earth swallows the rebels, fire consumes their company, and a plague is stayed only when Aaron makes atonement.

chapters.title: Aaron's Rod Buds and Blossoms
chapters.synopsis: To end the murmuring, twelve rods are laid before the Lord, one for each tribe. Aaron's rod buds, blossoms, and yields almonds, and it is kept before the testimony as a token against the rebels.

chapters.title: The Charge of Priests and Levites
chapters.synopsis: The Lord gives Aaron and his sons the charge of the sanctuary and grants them the offerings of Israel for their support. The Levites receive the tithes and in turn offer a tithe of the tithe to the priests.

chapters.title: The Ashes of the Red Heifer
chapters.synopsis: The Lord ordains that a red heifer without blemish be burned and its ashes kept for the water of separation. This water purifies those defiled by touching the dead, and neglecting it defiles the sanctuary.

chapters.title: Water from the Rock at Meribah
chapters.synopsis: Miriam dies at Kadesh, and the people strive for water. Moses smites the rock and water flows, but he and Aaron are barred from the promised land; Edom refuses passage, and Aaron dies on mount Hor.

chapters.title: The Serpent of Brass
chapters.synopsis: Israel defeats Arad, then murmurs and is bitten by fiery serpents; all who look on the brass serpent Moses raises are healed. Journeying on, Israel conquers Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan.

chapters.title: Balaam and the Speaking Ass
chapters.synopsis: Balak king of Moab hires the prophet Balaam to curse Israel. An angel blocks Balaam's way, his ass speaks, and he is permitted to go only on condition that he speak the word God gives him.

chapters.title: Israel Cannot Be Cursed
chapters.synopsis: Balak builds altars, but each time Balaam opens his mouth he blesses Israel instead of cursing them. God is not a man that he should lie, and no enchantment can prevail against Jacob.

chapters.title: The Star Out of Jacob
chapters.synopsis: Balaam, seeing Israel's tents, blesses them a third time and prophesies of a Star out of Jacob and a Sceptre out of Israel. He foretells the fate of Moab and the surrounding nations, and returns to his place.

chapters.title: Israel Snared at Baal-peor
chapters.synopsis: Israel commits whoredom with the daughters of Moab and bows to Baal-peor, and a plague breaks out. Phinehas turns away the Lord's wrath by his zeal and receives a covenant of an everlasting priesthood.

chapters.title: The Second Numbering of Israel
chapters.synopsis: In the plains of Moab a new census counts 601,730 men of war, by whose numbers the land will be divided. Of those numbered at Sinai, only Caleb and Joshua remain, as the Lord had sworn.

chapters.title: Joshua Chosen to Succeed Moses
chapters.synopsis: The daughters of Zelophehad win the right of daughters to inherit, and it becomes a statute in Israel. Moses views the land from mount Abarim, and Joshua is set before the congregation and given a charge.

chapters.title: The Continual Offerings Appointed
chapters.synopsis: The Lord appoints the daily, weekly, and monthly offerings, and those of passover and the day of firstfruits. Israel is to offer them in their due season as a continual sweet savour unto the Lord.

chapters.title: Offerings of the Seventh Month
chapters.synopsis: The Lord prescribes the offerings for the feast of trumpets, the day of atonement, and each day of the feast of tabernacles. The seventh month is filled with holy convocations and sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Law of Vows
chapters.synopsis: Moses declares the Lord's law of vows: a man must keep every word that proceeds out of his mouth. A woman's vow may be established or disallowed by her father or her husband on the day he hears it.

chapters.title: Vengeance Upon Midian
chapters.synopsis: At the Lord's command Israel wars against Midian for the matter of Peor, and Balaam is slain with the sword. The soldiers and spoil are purified, and the prey is divided between the warriors, the congregation, and the Lord.

chapters.title: Reuben and Gad Choose Their Land
chapters.synopsis: Reuben and Gad ask for the cattle lands east of Jordan, and Moses warns them not to discourage their brethren. They covenant to cross armed before Israel until the land is conquered, and receive their inheritance.

chapters.title: The Journeys of Israel Rehearsed
chapters.synopsis: Moses records the stages of Israel's journeys from Rameses in Egypt to the plains of Moab by Jordan. The Lord then commands Israel to drive out the inhabitants of Canaan and destroy their idols.

chapters.title: Borders of the Promised Land
chapters.synopsis: The Lord traces the borders of the land of Canaan that Israel is to inherit. Eleazar, Joshua, and a prince from each tribe are named to divide the inheritance west of Jordan.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: borders and dividers of the land

chapters.title: Cities of Refuge Appointed
chapters.synopsis: The Levites receive forty-eight cities with their suburbs, six of them cities of refuge. One who kills unawares may flee there from the avenger until judged, but no satisfaction may ransom a murderer.

chapters.title: Inheritance Kept Within the Tribe
chapters.synopsis: The family of Zelophehad's daughters raises the question of inheritances passing between tribes. Moses commands that heiresses marry within their father's tribe, and the daughters obey the word of the Lord.
